entries.summary: Removed the repo-wide change-freeze enforced by the unified-skillpack conformance check (tools/validate_unified_skillpacks.py, from the now-inert .claude/skillpacks/ migration). It fail-closed on any file changed outside a fixed allowed_change_paths list since a pinned base commit, which blocked ordinary, unrelated PRs. Replaced with a passive, non-enforcing record of files changed since the pinned base. This governance/change_log.json file is introduced at the same time as the self-tracker every federation repo now carries.

Adopted the change-coupled documentation gate defined by thehub-pr ADR 0010: the shared tools/check_docs_sync.py, a docs-sync workflow, a Claude Code Stop hook, CLAUDE.md, and this repo's .federation/docs-sync.json. Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr a86951e. The pre-commit hook, PR-template line and CONTRIBUTING sections this repo does not render from the hub were added by hand, and .gitignore now tracks .claude/settings.json. Tooling and workflow change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed. PROVISIONAL until docs-sync is a required status check on main.
